topic: DeleteSource and PurgeDocs stay open to interactive sessions under a policy
detail: RC-710 named DeleteSource and PurgeDocs alongside the settings RPCs, but D-74 and SP-078 cover only SetConfig with Sensitive keys, the harness and cc-safety-net settings, Restart and PR landing. Under a policy an interactive session can still delete a RAG source or purge a docs owner's chunks, which are not settings but remove memory other spaces may rely on. Options: (a) add both to policyOperatorOnly (Orch.app only under a policy), (b) let a session delete only sources in its own space, (c) keep them open. Recommended: (b) for DeleteSource, which agents use to clean up their own ingests, and (a) for PurgeDocs.
resolution: Settled as D-77; built by SP-026.
